review_notes: I read the whole file and the supporting lemmas it uses (`lpNorm_complex_finite_prod`, `lpNorm_complex_mul_le`, `lpNorm_finite_prod`, `lpNorm_mul_le`, `cjet_lpNorm_le`, `monoEval_tame_positive`, `familyJetNorm`). I also read Mathlib's `MemLp.prod`/`MemLp.fun_prod`, `eLpNorm_smul_le_mul_eLpNorm` and `lpNorm_const`. `monoEval_tame_zero` and `monoRemainder_uniform_bound` are tied to `ℂ`-valued jets, `familyJetNorm` over `ℝ`, and the `2*` factor from the real/imaginary split. Generalising them would not help anyone, so I made no finding there. I did not check that the generalised proof compiles. Two details need care. The empty-product case probably needs `NormOneClass`. The `IsBoundedSMul 𝕜 𝕜` instance for `NormedRing` has to resolve when `eLpNorm_smul_le_mul_eLpNorm` is applied.

findings.problem: The L²–L^∞ product bound is stated only for `ℂ`-valued functions. Nothing in its proof uses `ℂ` specifically. It needs the norm to be submultiplicative, the ring to be commutative so that `∏` makes sense, and `‖1‖ = 1` for the empty-product case. It rests on `lpNorm_complex_finite_prod`, whose proof is line-for-line the same as the real version `lpNorm_finite_prod` (the Hölder step `lpNorm_complex_mul_le` likewise copies `lpNorm_mul_le`). Mathlib's `MemLp.prod`/`MemLp.fun_prod` are already stated for any `NormedCommRing 𝕜`. `eLpNorm_smul_le_mul_eLpNorm` is stated for any `NormedRing 𝕜` with `IsBoundedSMul 𝕜 E`. The ℝ and ℂ copies of the same argument therefore exist only because the statements are specialised.
findings.proposed_change: Make the Hölder chain generic. State `lpNorm_finite_prod` and `lpNorm_mul_le` once for `{𝕜 : Type*} [NormedCommRing 𝕜] [NormOneClass 𝕜]` and `f : ι → Y → 𝕜`, using the same proof with `eLpNorm_smul_le_mul_eLpNorm` and `MemLp.fun_prod`. Then restate the target as `lemma lpNorm_prod_L2_Linf {𝕜 : Type*} [NormedCommRing 𝕜] [NormOneClass 𝕜] (f : κ → E → 𝕜) (i : κ) (hf2 : MemLp (f i) 2 volume) (hfi : ∀ j, MemLp (f j) ∞ volume) {A B : ℝ} (_hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hfa : ∀ j, lpNorm (f j) ∞ volume ≤ A) (hfb : lpNorm (f i) 2 volume ≤ B) : lpNorm (fun x => ∏ j, f j x) 2 volume ≤ B*A^(Fintype.card κ-1)`. The body stays unchanged apart from calling the generic Hölder lemma. `monoEval_tame_zero` keeps using the `ℂ` instance, so no call site changes. The empty-product case in the generic proof needs `NormOneClass`. The degenerate cases (zero measure, `κ` a singleton, `A = 0`) are handled as before.
findings.benefit: One Hölder product lemma serves ℝ-, ℂ- and any other normed-commutative-ring-valued functions. This removes the duplicate real/complex copies (`lpNorm_finite_prod`, `lpNorm_complex_finite_prod`, `lpNorm_mul_le`, `lpNorm_complex_mul_le`). The statement then says what the proof needs, and the real-valued analogue of this bound is available for free.
